# Disaster Response Hub — Executive Governance Health

Live view of audit ledger integrity, alert publication latency, agent handoff success, and kill-switch propagation. Spec-032 T508 must-land subset (FR-O04).

content.query:
AppMetrics
| where Name == 'audit.integrity_check.failures_total'
| summarize failures = sum(Sum) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| render timechart with (title='Audit ledger integrity-check failures (P1 if >0)')

AppMetrics
| where Name == 'alert.publish.lag_seconds'
| summarize p95 = percentile(Sum / Count, 95) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| render timechart with (title='Alert publish latency P95 (target <=90s)')

AppMetrics
| where Name == 'agent.handoff.success_total' or Name == 'agent.handoff.failure_total'
| summarize success = sumif(Sum, Name == 'agent.handoff.success_total'), failure = sumif(Sum, Name == 'agent.handoff.failure_total') by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| extend success_rate = todouble(success) / (todouble(success) + todouble(failure))
| render timechart with (title='Agent handoff success rate (target >=99.5%)')

AppMetrics
| where Name == 'agent.killswitch.lag_seconds'
| summarize p99 = percentile(Sum / Count, 99) by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| render timechart with (title='Kill-switch propagation P99 (target <=30s)')
